Name: Patrick
Summary: A fifth-century Romano-British Christian who, after being captured and enslaved in Ireland as a youth, returned there as a missionary bishop.
Contribution: His mission planted churches across Ireland and helped turn a land on the edge of the Roman world into a centre of Christian learning that would later send missionaries back to Europe.
KeyWorks: Confession; Letter to the Soldiers of Coroticus
Testimony: Having escaped slavery in Ireland, he chose to return to the people who had enslaved him in order to preach the gospel to them.
